Markets.title: India's 10-year bond posts best week in 7 years, leads emerging Asia as oil slides
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds achieved their best weekly performance in seven years, outperforming other Asian markets as benchmark yields dropped significantly. Falling crude oil prices following the US midterms attracted foreign investors and relieved pressure on the Reserve Bank of India to maintain high yields.

Markets.title: British Airways parent profit drops on higher fuel costs
Markets.summary: IAG's third-quarter net profit fell over 12 percent due to soaring fuel costs. The company also experienced flight disruptions and capacity reductions caused by the Middle East conflict and engine issues.

Markets.title: Siemens Q2 Results: Profit grows 5% to Rs 504 crore
Markets.summary: Siemens Limited reported a 4.78% increase in consolidated net profit to Rs 504 crore for the quarter ending September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations rose to Rs 5,734 crore while new orders surged 38% year-over-year to Rs 6,228 crore.

Markets.title: Indian rupee strengthens past 94/$ as oil slides, foreign inflows return
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened past 94 per dollar due to declining oil prices and strong foreign inflows into equities. The Reserve Bank of India also announced measures to support the currency.

Geo-Political.title: White House denies Hegseth and Rubio to leave jobs after Republican election losses
Geo-Political.summary: The White House denied US media reports that Pete Hegseth and Marco Rubio will leave their positions following Republican election losses. Hegseth faces a potential impeachment vote, and Rubio is rumored to be considering a presidential run.

Geo-Political.title: Trump signs order to preserve Oval Office as national monument
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump signed an executive order to preserve the Oval Office as a national monument. This action follows his recent modifications to the office's decor and the demolition of the White House East Wing.

Geo-Political.title: Two dead after bus crashes in France, officials say
Geo-Political.summary: A bus crash in France resulted in the deaths of one child and one young adult. Multiple other people sustained injuries in the accident.

Geo-Political.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
Geo-Political.summary: Kenyan doomsday cult leader Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to life in prison for murdering 191 people. Mackenzie had ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could meet Jesus.

Geo-Political.title: Pope begins lengthy trip to Latin America weeks after lung cancer surgery
Geo-Political.summary: Pope Leo is beginning a lengthy trip to Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru. This international travel comes just weeks after he had part of his lung removed due to cancer.

Geo-Political.title: Tanzanian opposition leader found guilty of inciting unrest but acquitted of treason
Geo-Political.summary: A Tanzanian opposition leader has been found guilty of inciting unrest after being detained since April of last year. However, he was acquitted of separate treason charges, which he claims are politically motivated.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found their WordPress SaaS course recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best industry recommendations. This discovery highlights the growing shift toward AIO (Artificial Intelligence Optimization) over traditional SEO for generating free organic traffic.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

Data & Insights.title: Bond yield rise squeezes banks' Q2 treasury gains
Data & Insights.summary: Rising bond yields caused public and private banks to suffer treasury income losses in the second quarter. This elevated yield environment is expected to continue putting pressure on bank earnings through the December quarter.

Data & Insights.title: Internship scheme's new pilot gets more takers post rejig
Data & Insights.summary: About 40,000 candidates have joined the third pilot round of the PM Internship Scheme, which is 2.5 times the turnout of the first two rounds. This positive response has encouraged the corporate affairs ministry to launch the full programme next year without additional pilots.

Data & Insights.title: India gets Strait of Hormuz passage reprieve from Iran. What does Tehran expect in return?
Data & Insights.summary: Iran is granting Indian ships selective exemptions to pass through the Strait of Hormuz to maintain its own medical supplies, energy exports, and diplomatic interests. In return, Tehran expects India to continue its strategic and diplomatic cooperation despite broader regional tensions.

Data & Insights.title: Food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending as inflation rises: NABARD survey
Data & Insights.summary: A recent NABARD survey shows that food accounts for 53.5% of rural household spending amid rising inflation. Consequently, rural families face growing financial strain as their savings erode and borrowing increases.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Primer | How will the blue tsunami in the US mid-terms benefit India?
Data & Insights.summary: The US mid-term elections could result in a Democratic-led Congress that restrains President Trump's foreign policy actions. Consequently, expectations are that Trump will pursue a negotiated settlement to the Iran conflict rather than maintaining aggressive military strategies.

Data & Insights.title: Snack makers tweak trade margins, engineer pouches to break  ₹5 pack habit
Data & Insights.summary: Rising costs of ingredients and packaging are squeezing profit margins on cheap snack packs. To combat this, snack makers are pushing larger package sizes, redesigning pouches, and expanding premium product lines.

India.title: 'E20 Actually Has Over 30% Ethanol': Karnataka Minister Cites Petrol Tests, Demands Consumer Relief Fund
India.summary: Karnataka Consumer Affairs Minister Rizwan Arshad announced that tests on 63 state-wide petrol samples revealed ethanol levels up to 31.2%, exceeding the declared 20%. Arshad subsequently demanded the creation of a consumer relief fund to address this discrepancy.

India.title: Classes In Hybrid Mode, Restrictions On Cars: What Changes Under GRAP-III
India.summary: Delhi authorities invoked GRAP-III restrictions early as a precautionary measure, even though the air quality index had not yet reached the severe threshold of 400. These restrictions include conducting classes in hybrid mode and implementing limitations on cars.

India.title: Manipur Insurgent Charged Under Anti-Terror Law Arrested In Delhi
India.summary: A Manipur insurgent charged under an anti-terror law has been arrested in Delhi. The Delhi Police Crime Branch carried out the operation that led to the arrest.

India.title: Stricter Pollution Curbs Under GRAP-III Imposed In Delhi-NCR Ahead Of Diwali
India.summary: Delhi and the National Capital Region have implemented stricter Stage-III pollution curbs under GRAP after the average Air Quality Index reached 382. The Commission for Air Quality Management introduced these immediate restrictions as a precautionary measure ahead of Diwali.

India.title: Delhi Metro Services On 3 Lines To Start Early On Diwali, Last Train At 10 pm
India.summary: On Diwali, Delhi Metro services on three lines will begin earlier than usual in the morning. Additionally, the last trains across all lines will depart from terminal stations at 10 pm instead of 11 pm.

India.title: CAT 2026 Admit Card Out: Know How To Download, Check Exam Details
India.summary: The CAT 2026 admit cards were released on November 6 on the official website, iimcat.ac.in. Candidates can download their hall tickets by logging in with their user ID and password.

General.title: Met chief says he wouldn't be surprised if more allegations made about Brand after rape conviction
General.summary: Met Police chief Sir Mark Rowley stated he would not be surprised if more women came forward with allegations against Russell Brand following a recent rape conviction. Rowley also criticized comments made during the trial for coming close to victim blaming.

General.title: Did a data centre revolt affect the US midterm election results?
General.summary: BBC Verify is investigating whether the rapid growth of data centres and rising anti-AI sentiment influenced voters in the US midterm elections. The report explores how public backlash against these technological developments might impact the future of the industry.

General.title: 'Misleading' student loans information left out examples of higher-salary repayments
General.summary: The Treasury Committee chair expressed shock after a university used misleading student loan information that compared repayments to the cost of coffee. The promotional material omitted examples of higher-salary repayments.

General.title: Firms should publish salaries in job adverts ahead of new law, says PM
General.summary: The Prime Minister advises companies to include salary details in job listings before a new law makes it mandatory. The government states this requirement will assist jobseekers and help prevent pay discrimination.
